decisive_items: brownish macules on the hands and feet
multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
response.rationale: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome is uniquely supported by mucocutaneous pigmentation plus multiple GI polyps; celiac and Crohn's lack these pathognomonic features.

rejected.why: Only nonspecific diarrhea, pain, and weight loss; no polyps or pigmentation.
Malabsorption signs are present but no polyps or mucocutaneous melanin deposits.
